newsitem.title: UK: Dixons up on digital TV group announcement.
newsitem.headline: Dixons up on digital TV group announcement.

text.p: Shares in Dixons Group Plc raced ahead on Friday on hopes the new digital television alliance announced by British Sky Broadcasting, Carlton Communications and Granada Group Plc would mean a surge in television and equipment sales for the electronic retailer, dealers said.
By 1009 GMT, Dixons shares were up 15p to 522-1/2 on trading volume of 2.3 million shares.
The group said British Digital Broadcasting, the new venture, plans to offer 15 subscription channels from its three members and the British Broadcasting Corp to broadcast

Positive comments from broker SBC Warburg also lent support to Dixons, dealers said. The broker has repeated its bullish stance on the stock, citing, among other factors, the long-term profit potential stemming from the digital TV introduction, dealers said. Dixons stock was its leading buy recommendation in the sector for the year.
SBC Warburg was not immediately available to comment.
